title: A plan that stays put
hook: Two stated cases: explore the financial horizon of switching.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the financial horizon of switching affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Saving, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the financial horizon of switching in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
